title: ADVANCES IN LLM REASONING ENABLE FLEXIBILITY IN CLINICAL PROBLEM-SOLVING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM and human performance on the medicine abstraction and reasoning corpus (mARC), an adversarial medical question-answering benchmark. The dataset uses clinical vignettes designed to trigger stereotyped default heuristics (Einstellung traps) to test whether models can flexibly override these familiar patterns using deductive constraints and background medical knowledge.
